external_entities.name: user's browser
external_entities.description: A user's browser that initiates communication with the web application.
external_entities.source_excerpt: A user's browser talks to the web application over HTTP/S across the public internet.

processes.name: web application
processes.description: The web application that receives browser traffic and puts jobs onto a message queue.
processes.source_excerpt: The web application does not do the heavy work itself. It puts jobs onto a message queue

processes.name: background worker process
processes.description: The background worker process that picks up jobs and does the work.
processes.source_excerpt: a background worker process picks them up and does the work.

data_stores.name: message queue
data_stores.description: A queue where the web application puts jobs for the background worker process.
data_stores.source_excerpt: It puts jobs onto a message queue

data_stores.name: database
data_stores.description: The database read and written by the background worker process; it also stores the application's log records.
data_stores.source_excerpt: The database is also where we keep the application's log records.

data_stores.name: web application config
data_stores.description: The configuration store for the web application, including the web application's queue credentials.
data_stores.source_excerpt: the web application has a web application config

data_stores.name: worker config
data_stores.description: The configuration store for the worker, including the worker's database credentials.
data_stores.source_excerpt: the worker has a worker config

data_flows.name: talks to application
data_flows.description: The user's browser talks to the web application.
data_flows.source_excerpt: A user's browser talks to the web application over HTTP/S across the public internet.

data_flows.name: puts jobs
data_flows.description: The web application puts jobs onto the message queue.
data_flows.source_excerpt: It puts jobs onto a message queue
data_flows.notes: The description does not say how the web application authenticates to the queue.

data_flows.name: picks up jobs
data_flows.description: The background worker process picks jobs up from the message queue.
data_flows.source_excerpt: a background worker process picks them up and does the work.

data_flows.name: reads and writes
data_flows.description: The background worker process reads and writes the database.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The background worker reads and writes the database.
data_flows.notes: The description does not say how the worker authenticates to the database.

data_flows.name: reads settings
data_flows.description: The web application reads its settings from the web application config.
data_flows.source_excerpt: Both processes read their settings from a config store: the web application has a web application config
data_flows.notes: The web application config holds the web application's queue credentials.

data_flows.name: reads settings
data_flows.description: The background worker process reads its settings from the worker config.
data_flows.source_excerpt: Both processes read their settings from a config store: ... the worker has a worker config.
data_flows.notes: The worker config holds the worker's database credentials.

trust_boundaries.name: public internet
trust_boundaries.description: The public internet outside the system's network, where the user's browser sits.

trust_boundaries.name: web tier
trust_boundaries.description: The web tier where the web application runs.
trust_boundaries.source_excerpt: the web application runs in our web tier

trust_boundaries.name: backend tier
trust_boundaries.description: The backend tier behind the web tier, containing the queue, worker and database.
trust_boundaries.source_excerpt: The queue, the worker and the database are all in the backend tier, behind the web tier.

assumptions.basis: A user's browser reaches the web application across the public internet.

assumptions.assumption: The web application config contains confidential data.
assumptions.basis: The web application config holds the web application's queue credentials.

assumptions.assumption: The worker config contains confidential data.
assumptions.basis: The worker config holds the worker's database credentials.
